fields.description: Masaar 2 is Arada’s second forested mastercommunity in Sharjah. Its four districts combine townhouses and villas with a lagoon, walking routes and places for sport, distinct from the original Masaar and the later Masaar 3.

overview: The four collections are Melia, Narenj, Anber and Coral. Their original documents offer two- to four-bedroom townhouses and four- to five-bedroom villas.
The December 2025 construction award covers 1,997 homes on a 10.5-million-ft² site. Earlier launch material rounded the programme to 2,000 homes.
research.locationNote: Arada identifies Sharjah’s Rowdat district, near the original Masaar and Nasma Residences, with access to Khorfakkan Road and Emirates Road. Bayut groups the phases under Al Sehma.
research.priceNote: The developer landing still advertises AED 1.57 million for a two-bedroom townhouse, while its February 2025 release announced all four phases sold out. Treat the displayed figure as a marketing reference, not confirmed current stock.
research.paymentNote: Table: developer landing reference, 5/35/60. Bayut phase guides differ, including Melia at 35/65. No verified current unit-specific calendar was available; confirm the applicable contract.
research.handoverNote: The 4 December 2025 construction award targets first handovers in 2027 and full completion by June 2028. The headline reflects the latter mastercommunity forecast, not every home’s delivery date.

units.label: 5-bedroom Forest Signature A/B
units.note: Published whole-home total; Villa B’s components conflict. Coral’s reviewed pack shows A only.

facts.label: Construction award
facts.value: AED 2.7 billion package announced 4 December 2025. Intermass: phases 1, 3 and 4; Pivot: phase 2.

facts.label: Site-preparation milestone
facts.value: Developer reported enabling works complete in December 2025; not a completed-home certificate.

facts.label: Landscape programme
facts.value: 40,000 trees planned within the green spine.

facts.label: Launch status
facts.value: All four phases reported sold out on 27 February 2025; resale or later releases need separate confirmation.
